name: The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf
notes: Chain location; work-list address 12314 Poway Road matches this DoorDash store's own FAQ address ('12314 Poway Rd, Poway, CA 92064') exactly. This restaurant's own Olo storefront (playbook: 'Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf's Olo storefront has defeated five attempts') was not retried; DoorDash was used instead as a different route. The page's schema.org JSON-LD Menu block only exposed 91 of the store's items across 7 sections (a curated subset -- Teas, Ice Blended drinks, Cold Brew, Cocoas, Retail were all missing from it) even though the page's own escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push, MenuBookCategory / MenuPageItemList / MenuPageItem objects) held the complete 24-category, 260-item catalog matching the category metadata's own numItems counts exactly. Used the RSC payload instead of the JSON-LD. Dropped the 'Most Ordered' carousel entirely (all 12 items were exact-name duplicates of items already present in their real categories). Dropped 3 items with no resolvable price ('Brewed Coffee' x2, 'Red Eye') per the never-write-a-dish-without-a-real-price rule -- these are build-your-own drinks whose modifier price could not be resolved from this payload (isEligible:false on the quick-add price with a $0 base). Items whose grid price is a 'from' price (build-your-own with required size/flavor choice) are noted as such in their description; the number recorded is the storefront's own displayed 'starting at' figure, not invented. Markup check: divided all 257 non-'from' prices by 1.04/1.10/1.15/1.20/1.25 -- none landed cleanly on round or .95 values (max 15% at 1.10, within the ~17-23% organic-noise band), so no delivery markup detected; treated as base restaurant pricing. Dropped the two 'Retail' categories (Coffee/Tea/Powders take-home bags, Merchandise) as adjunct retail rather than a drink/food menu. Categories captured: Seasonal Offerings, Food (Baked Goods, Breakfast, Lunch, Snacks & Treats), Coffee (The Perfect Americano, Iced Espresso, Espresso, Iced Coffee, Brewed Coffee), Cold Brew (Coffee, Tea), Ice Blended drink (Coffee Based, Kid Friendly, Tea Based), Tea (Hot Tea, Iced Tea, Hot Tea Latte, Iced Tea Latte), Cocoas, Bottled Beverages, Catering (Java To Go).
